mentat.comment: PLATINUM_RULES §21 — Mentat does the physics. SkippyTel's public Mentat (Cloud Run: no Qwen, so no GPU) as a remote MCP server: one shared service, nothing spawned per session; tools appear as mcp__mentat__*. Claude Desktop / claude.ai / phone use the same URL as the custom connector `mentat` (skippy-tel CLAUDE.md). The Qwen-backed copy on skippy-pc stays private to the portal chat; shell access to it: tools/mentat_call.sh.
